schema.conferences:
CREATE TABLE conferences (
          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, acronym TEXT NOT NULL, rank TEXT NOT NULL,
          area TEXT NOT NULL, full_name TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.records:
CREATE TABLE records (
          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conference_id TEXT REFERENCES conferences(id),
          year INTEGER NOT NULL, award_type TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL,
          date_start TEXT, date_end TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL,
          payload TEXT NOT NULL, sources TEXT NOT NULL,
          created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          reviewer TEXT, review_note TEXT)
schema.award_events:
CREATE TABLE award_events (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, venue TEXT NOT NULL, conference_id TEXT,
      year INTEGER NOT NULL, official_award_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      category TEXT NOT NULL, student_only INTEGER NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY(conference_id) REFERENCES conferences(id))
schema.award_papers:
CREATE TABLE award_papers (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, venue TEXT NOT NULL, year INTEGER NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL, authors_raw TEXT, paper_url TEXT)
schema.award_event_papers:
CREATE TABLE award_event_papers (
      annotation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES award_events(id),
      paper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES award_papers(id), source_url TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_page_id TEXT NOT NULL, evidence TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending')
schema.source_listings:
CREATE TABLE source_listings (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      paper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES award_papers(id),
      source_venue TEXT NOT NULL, conference_id TEXT REFERENCES conferences(id),
      source_row INTEGER NOT NULL,
      area_raw TEXT, authors_raw TEXT, source_url TEXT NOT NULL,
      discovery_url TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE(source_name,paper_id))
schema.source_listing_records:
CREATE TABLE source_listing_records (
      listing_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_listings(id),
      record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
      PRIMARY KEY(listing_id,record_id))

RTSS 2022
The IEEE Real-Time Systems Symposium (RTSS) is the premier conference in the field of real-time systems and is a venue for researchers and practitioners to showcase innovations covering all aspects of real-time systems, including theory, design, analysis, implementation, evaluation, and experience. RTSS ’22, celebrating the 43rd anniversary of the event, continues the trend of making RTSS an expansive and inclusive event, striving to embrace new and emerging areas of real-time systems research.

The IEEE Real-Time Systems Symposium (RTSS) is the premier conference in the field of real-time systems and is a venue for researchers and practitioners to showcase innovations covering all aspects of real-time systems, including theory, design, analysis, implementation, evaluation, and experience. RTSS ’23, celebrating the 44th anniversary of the event, continues the trend of making RTSS an expansive and inclusive event, striving to embrace new and emerging areas of real-time systems research. It is to be held in Taipei from Dec. 5 to 8, 2023.
